Book Review: The Smartest Investment Book You’ll Ever Read by Dan Solin

April 19, 2024 Book Review
This book does a good job of introducing basic investment concepts, and then moves on to explaining many of the pitfalls of investors.  Investors try to pick funds that will outperform based on historical outperformance, but studies show there is no predictive power from one five-year period to the next.  The most respected mutual fund rating system in the world, the Morningstar Star System does not show statistically significant performance edge for five star rated funds over four and even three-star funds.  Even Morningstar cautions that its system is not a predictor of future results.
